package learningplanner

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func (c Client) diagnosticRequest(ctx context.Context, method, studentID, planID, suffix string, output any) error {
	if !canonicalUUID(studentID) || !canonicalUUID(planID) || c.HTTPClient == nil || strings.TrimSpace(c.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(c.InternalToken) == "" {
		return domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	var body io.Reader
	if method == http.MethodPost {
		body = strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"diagnostic-placement-consume.v1"}`)
	}
	endpoint := strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/diagnostic-assessment-plans/" + url.PathEscape(planID) + "/" + suffix
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, endpoint, body)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	if method == http.MethodPost {
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", planID)
	}
	response, err := c.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusNotFound, http.StatusForbidden, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
		return domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum
	case http.StatusConflict:
		return domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || !jsonMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
		return domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	payload, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, (64<<10)+1))
	if err != nil || len(payload) > 64<<10 {
		return domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(payload))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(output) != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		return domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	return nil
}

func (c Client) EnsureDiagnosticPlacement(ctx context.Context, studentID, planID string) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementSummary, error) {
	var wire struct {
		Schema                string    `json:"schema"`
		StudentID             string    `json:"student_id"`
		CourseID              string    `json:"course_id"`
		CourseContentRevision string    `json:"course_content_revision"`
		PolicyVersion         string    `json:"policy_version"`
		AttemptID             string    `json:"attempt_id"`
		PlanID                string    `json:"plan_id"`
		PlanRevision          int       `json:"plan_revision"`
		Correct               int       `json:"correct"`
		Total                 int       `json:"total"`
		Percent               int       `json:"percent"`
		Band                  string    `json:"band"`
		BandPolicyVersion     string    `json:"band_policy_version"`
		PlanDigest            string    `json:"plan_digest"`
		ResultDigest          string    `json:"result_digest"`
		ResultCompletedAt     time.Time `json:"result_completed_at"`
		RouteCode             string    `json:"route_code"`
		RoutePolicyVersion    string    `json:"route_policy_version"`
		DecidedAt             time.Time `json:"decided_at"`
		DecisionDigest        string    `json:"decision_digest"`
	}
	if err := c.diagnosticRequest(ctx, http.MethodPost, studentID, planID, "placement", &wire); err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacementSummary{}, err
	}
	if wire.Schema != "diagnostic-placement.v1" || wire.StudentID != studentID || wire.PlanID != planID || wire.AttemptID != planID || !canonicalUUID(wire.CourseID) || wire.Total <= 0 || wire.Correct < 0 || wire.Correct > wire.Total || wire.Percent < 0 || wire.Percent > 100 || wire.PlanRevision < 1 || wire.ResultCompletedAt.IsZero() || wire.DecidedAt.IsZero() || !regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$`).MatchString(wire.DecisionDigest) || wire.RoutePolicyVersion != "diagnostic-placement-route-v1" {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacementSummary{}, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	valid := map[string]string{"FOUNDATION": "START_FOUNDATION", "CORE": "START_CORE", "ADVANCED": "START_ADVANCED"}
	digest := regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$`)
	if wire.PolicyVersion != "diagnostic-fixed-v1" || wire.BandPolicyVersion != "diagnostic-placement-band-v1" || !digest.MatchString(wire.ResultDigest) || !digest.MatchString(wire.PlanDigest) || strings.TrimSpace(wire.CourseContentRevision) == "" || wire.Total < 3 || wire.Total > 5 || wire.Percent != wire.Correct*100/wire.Total || wire.DecidedAt.Before(wire.ResultCompletedAt) {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacementSummary{}, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	if valid[wire.Band] == "" || valid[wire.Band] != wire.RouteCode {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacementSummary{}, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	return domain.DiagnosticPlacementSummary{Band: wire.Band, RouteCode: wire.RouteCode, RoutePolicyVersion: wire.RoutePolicyVersion, DecisionDigest: wire.DecisionDigest}, nil
}

func (c Client) GetDiagnosticPlanningState(ctx context.Context, studentID, planID string) (domain.DiagnosticPlanningState, error) {
	var state domain.DiagnosticPlanningState
	if err := c.diagnosticRequest(ctx, http.MethodGet, studentID, planID, "planning-state", &state); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if state.Schema != "diagnostic-planning-state.v1" || state.PlanID != planID || state.GoalCode == "" || len(state.GoalCode) > 64 || state.OnboardingVersion < 1 || state.DirectionCode == "" {
		return state, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	if state.Request != nil {
		r := state.Request
		if !canonicalUUID(r.RequestID) || (r.Status != "REQUESTED" && r.Status != "PLANNING" && r.Status != "COMPLETED" && r.Status != "FAILED") || (r.LearningPathID != "" && !canonicalUUID(r.LearningPathID)) {
			return state, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
		}
		if len(r.FailureCode) > 64 || len(r.ResultCode) > 64 ||
			((r.Status == "REQUESTED" || r.Status == "PLANNING") && (r.ResultCode != "" || r.FailureCode != "" || r.LearningPathID != "")) ||
			(r.Status == "FAILED" && (r.FailureCode == "" || r.ResultCode != "" || r.LearningPathID != "")) ||
			(r.Status == "COMPLETED" && (r.FailureCode != "" || (r.LearningPathID == "" && r.ResultCode != "NO_GAP"))) {
			return state, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
		}
	}
	return state, nil
}
